question: What did xbid.ai submit to Stellar Hacks: KALE x Reflector, how did it place, and does Scout's project directory list it now?

golden.answer: As of 2026-10-06: xbid.ai submitted a multi-LLM AI agent that trades on Stellar (DoraHacks BUIDL 32593). In the team's write-up it runs delta-neutral strategies and feeds its own results back into its behavior; the submission tags itself with SDEX, Blend, and Reflector. It took 1st place at Stellar Hacks: KALE x Reflector. Scout links the submission to the directory project XBid AI (slug `xbid-ai`). The link is made through the demo site xbid.ai, and the project's directory status is Live. The submission links the GitHub organization github.com/xbid-ai, not one repository, so Scout holds no declared-package stack or repository activity for the submission. The write-up is the team's claim, not proof of what shipped.
keyFacts: xbid.ai submitted a multi-LLM AI agent that trades on Stellar.
It took 1st place at Stellar Hacks: KALE x Reflector.
Scout links the submission to the directory project XBid AI.
The linked project's directory status is Live.
avoid: States that xbid.ai did not place at Stellar Hacks: KALE x Reflector.
States that Scout's directory has never listed the linked XBid AI project.
golden.notes: The first-place result is supported by the team's dated announcement and by DoraHacks' published hackathon summary. The project link and the Live status are Scout's directory records on 2026-10-06; accept a newer dated Scout status. A Scout listing does not establish SDF directory membership, an initial listing date, funding, or current production operation. The link basis (demo website), the GitHub-organization detail, and the missing stack are nice-to-have; the missing stack does not mean missing code. Scout's record showed no SCF award on that date; that is not a required fact.
